note:
The Hardstaff household at 23 Hope Drive (#362) on the 1911 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. All six were already in the record there (#1021-#1026), so each is bound by number and only the blanks are filled: Florence Betty's age and birth year, the birthplaces, marital status and occupations.

Left for checking against the image, since an import never overwrites: the maternity nurse is 'Elizabeth Bayro' in the record and 'Baiylo' in this transcription, born at Dawley, Shropshire; and the baby is 'Florence Betty' in the record, 'Florence Berty' here.

Wright's Directory of Nottingham has 'Hardstaff Bernard, perambulator manufacturer' at 23 Hope Drive in 1910-11, and at The Bungalow, Clare Valley (the record's Ribble Lodge, #65) in 1913-14 and 1915-16; the return calls him a commercial traveller, likely for the family business of Thomas Hardstaff, perambulator maker of The Ropewalk. The family moved twice after 1911: Wright's Directory has them at The Bungalow, Clare Valley in 1913-14 and 1915-16, and the 1921 schedule, signed by Mr B. Hardstaff, gives 23 Park Valley, The Park, where the record files them. Emily Goodman (#1026) is also the record's 1921 servant at Elmhurst, Cavendish Road East; the ages agree.
source: 1911 census, 23 Hope Drive, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1910-11, page 111 (Leicester Special Collections id 165787); 1913-14, page 80 (id 166436); 1915-16, page 82 (id 347723).
